text: A beam of light rising from stone and focusing into a single point: a soft, low swell climbs quickly, narrows and brightens, then settles into one firm, solid landing that fades quickly.
Energy rushing up out of a stone floor and condensing to a point of light: a quick rising swell ending on one firm, solid thump with a short fade.
A low, warm rush of flame wrapping around someone, with a steady soft burn beneath it.
Soft flames sweeping up and curling around a body, a deep warm whoomp settling into a gentle steady burn.
A cold breath drawn in, with fine ice crystals tinkling and forming in the air around it.
Freezing air gathering around someone: a slow icy inhale as tiny ice crystals form and glitter.
A soft, damp hiss of fine water vapour spreading outward, gentle and hushed.
A cool, wet mist rolling out in all directions: a hushed, airy spray of fine droplets, soft and even.
A deep, heavy rumble of stone settling onto someone, like a boulder shifting its weight.
Heavy rock grinding slowly into place around a body: a low rumbling shift of great weight that comes to rest.
